rule: PREREG_R6 5.4: per episode e, a screen candidate c is S-eligible iff its export is ok, it has 3 ok official runs, none flagged by the own-input gate (5.3), and own-input SP-SR = MP-SR = 1 in >= 2 of its 3 runs; cons_S(c) = float64 mean of its 3 variant-B consensus AUCs; finalist f_e = the S-eligible c with the highest cons_S(c) among those with cons_S(c) >= m_P_frozen(e) + 0.01 (exact floats); ties: lower population variance of its 3 consensus AUCs, lower mean consensus MPPE, job name; otherwise no finalist.
